title: From phone invitation to arena
slide_intent: Connect a small digital invitation with its physical destination so the service promise feels concrete.
strategic_value: O2 can associate a mobile Priority interaction with the scale and atmosphere of an arena experience.
demonstration: A split image pairs a hand using an O2-branded artist promotion on a phone with an aerial evening view of The O2 arena and London beyond.
practical_value: Use paired contexts to show how a brand experience continues from a device into a real place.

content_islands.name: Phone interaction
content_islands.spec: Fill the left half with a close view of the hand and phone in a dark event setting, keeping the promotion readable.

content_islands.name: Arena destination
content_islands.spec: Fill the right half with the aerial arena photograph, preserving its blue and warm evening lighting.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying source section explicitly describes an identity stretching from screen to arena.
reference_purposes.Application: The side-by-side image connects a phone promotion with the physical event destination.
reference_purposes.Expression: Blue and warm light link the two photographic settings.
